narrative:

Mean daily demand is 2847 units with standard deviation 599.
Lead time is moderately stable (CV=0.229) with mean 1.13 days.

The classical EOQ model recommends 29037 units, but this is constrained by storage capacity to 24308 units.
With 95% service level target, safety stock is 1599 units, yielding a reorder point of 4805 units.
Review period is approximately 9 days.

The capacity constraint forces a trade-off: ordering more frequently (increasing ordering costs) 
to maintain service level within storage limits. Total annual cost is $4094.45.
